title: Security Analyst
description:
Securin is an AI-native cybersecurity company. Our Preemptive Exposure Management Platform turns exposure data into clear decisions — giving organizations the confidence to know which risks are exploitable, what to fix first, and how to act before attackers do.

Duties and Responsibilities:

OT / ICS Penetration Testing:

* Plan and execute safety-first penetration tests of OT/ICS environments (water and wastewater, energy, manufacturing, building systems), including passive asset discovery, Purdue-model segmentation testing and IT-to-OT pivot analysis.
* Assess PLCs, RTUs, HMIs, SCADA servers, historians and engineering workstations across major vendors (e.g., Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Schneider Electric) and SCADA platforms (e.g., VTScada, Ignition, AVEVA/Wonderware).
* Test industrial protocols such as Modbus/TCP, DNP3, EtherNet/IP/CIP, S7comm, OPC UA, BACnet and IEC 60870-5-104/61850 for authentication, integrity and logic-manipulation weaknesses.
* Build and use lab or digital-twin replicas to validate attack paths before touching production; operate strictly within client-approved rules of engagement, change windows and safety constraints.
* Map findings to ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82 and MITRE ATT&CK for ICS, with remediation guidance that is realistic for plant operations.

Exploit Development & Zero-Day Discovery:

* Conduct vulnerability research on binaries, firmware, embedded/IoT devices, web applications and enterprise software using reverse engineering, source code review and fuzzing (coverage-guided, protocol-aware and grammar-based).
* Write reliable proof-of-concept and weaponized exploits for memory corruption (stack/heap overflows, use-after-free, type confusion), logic flaws and authentication bypasses, including bypass of modern mitigations (ASLR, DEP/NX, CFG, stack canaries).
* Perform n-day analysis and patch diffing to rapidly validate exploitability of newly disclosed CVEs for clients and for Securin’s exposure intelligence.
* Apply AI-augmented techniques, such as LLM-assisted code review, agent-driven fuzz harness generation and automated crash triage, to scale discovery within Securin’s Zero Day program.
* Run coordinated vulnerability disclosure with vendors, CERTs and CNAs, and author technical advisories and research publications.

AI & Agentic System Pentesting:

* Assess LLM applications, RAG pipelines, autonomous agents and tool integrations (including MCP servers and plugins) for direct and indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, sensitive data disclosure, excessive agency, insecure output handling, tool abuse and supply-chain weaknesses.
* Test against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, OWASP agentic AI threat guidance, MITRE ATLAS and the NIST AI RMF, and translate results into concrete architectural fixes.
* Build and operate automated adversarial testing harnesses (e.g., PyRIT, garak, promptfoo) and custom attack agents for repeatable AI red teaming.
* Contribute offensive techniques and agent workflows to Securin’s AI-driven offensive security platform and autonomous pentesting research.

Core Delivery & Team Contribution:

* Conduct network, web application, API, cloud and red team engagements, emulating real-world adversaries using the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Develop and execute detailed test plans and methodologies; manage engagement timelines, deadlines and client expectations.
* Prepare high-quality reports using Securin templates and present findings to technical and executive stakeholders in kick-off calls and readouts.
* Advise developers, system administrators and OT engineers on secure configuration, coding best practices and remediation.
* Mentor analysts, contribute to internal training, methodology and tooling, and help shape report deliverables.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum 2-5 years of hands-on penetration testing and offensive security experience, including significant depth in at least two of: OT/ICS security, exploit development/vulnerability research, and AI/LLM security.
* Demonstrated OT/ICS penetration testing experience on real industrial environments or high-fidelity labs, with a strong grasp of safety-first testing practices.
* Proven exploit-writing ability, evidenced by original vulnerability research: CVE credits, published advisories or exploits, conference talks, or high-level bug bounty/CTF results.
* Hands-on experience testing LLM applications or agentic AI systems, with a working understanding of how models, retrieval, tools and permissions combine to create attack surface.
* Strong programming skills in Python and C/C++, and working knowledge of x86/x64 and ARM assembly; Bash/PowerShell required; Rust or Go a plus.
* Proficiency with reverse engineering and debugging tools (IDA Pro, Ghidra, Binary Ninja, WinDbg, GDB with pwndbg/GEF), fuzzers (AFL++, libFuzzer, boofuzz) and offensive tooling (Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Wireshark with ICS dissectors, C2 frameworks such as Cobalt Strike or Sliver).
* Familiarity with industry standards and frameworks including OWASP Top 10, CVE/CWE, OSSTMM, NIST, MITRE ATT&CK, ISA/IEC 62443 and MITRE ATLAS.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Electrical/Control Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Excellent written and spoken English; able to convey complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Core AI Specific Skill Requirements in General:**

Securin is committed to becoming an AI-native organization where GenAI is embedded into how every team works - not just as an occasional assistant, but as a core part of delivery, operations, and how our expertise compounds over time. We expect every employee to integrate GenAI tools into daily workflows actively - automating routine tasks, accelerating research and analysis, drafting documents, and building reusable AI-powered processes for their function. You should understand the limitations of GenAI (including inaccuracies and data sensitivity boundaries), follow data classification rules, and continuously improve your AI proficiency. As you grow, we expect you to move beyond using GenAI to building with it - designing agent workflows, contributing reusable skills, and helping Securin compound its Proactive Exposure Management expertise faster than any competitor can replicate.

* Demonstrated ability to use GenAI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) for daily work - drafting, research, summarization, data analysis, code generation, or workflow automation as relevant to the role
* Working knowledge of GenAI limitations including hallucination risk, context window constraints, and data sensitivity boundaries; ability to validate AI-generated output before acting on it
* Familiarity with prompt engineering techniques - structuring multi-step instructions, providing context, and iterating on output quality to achieve production-grade results
* Comfort with Agentic AI workflows - using, designing, or building multi-step AI agents that execute tasks autonomously with human-in-the-loop validation
* Awareness of AI security fundamentals - prompt injection risks, data classification rules, sandboxed execution, and responsible handling of sensitive data in AI workflows
* Familiarity with connecting GenAI tools to internal data sources, APIs, and enterprise systems
* Ability to contribute reusable AI skills, templates, agent configurations, or automation workflows to a shared repository for team-wide use
* Willingness to learn and adopt new AI tools as they evolve; participation in AI adoption sprints, hackathons, and knowledge-sharing within the team

**Preferred Certifications:**

Certifications are a plus, not a substitute for demonstrated skill. Public research, CVEs and exploits carry equal or greater weight.

**Preferred certifications / evidence**

**Exploit development & offensive:**

OSCP, OSEP, OSED, OSWE, OSEE, OSCE³, GIAC GXPN, CRTO, CRTP/CRTE, HTB certifications

**OT / ICS security:**

GIAC GICSP, GRID or GCIP; ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Specialist/Expert; SANS ICS410/ICS515/ICS612 training

**AI / LLM security:**

AI red teaming certifications or training (e.g., HTB AI Red Teamer path, C-AI/MLPen), or published AI security research

**Research track record**

* CVE credits, vendor advisories, Pwn2Own/DEF CON-level CTF results, bug bounty rankings, conference talks

title: Senior Lead Product Security Engineer
description:
**An Amazing Career Opportunity for Senior Lead Product Security Engineer**
**Location: Chennai, India (Hybrid)**
**Job ID: 52177**
**Profile Summary:**
The Product Vulnerability Management Lead operates the day-to-day product vulnerability management program across a diverse product portfolio. Reporting to the Senior Product Vulnerability Manager, this role turns enterprise standards into consistent execution by product teams, ensuring vulnerabilities are triaged, prioritized, remediated, disclosed, and reported in an auditable manner.
  
  
**About HID Global**
HID Global powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places and things. We make it possible for people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely. Our trusted identity solutions give people secure and convenient access to physical and digital places and connect things that can be accurately identified, verified and tracked digitally. Millions of people around the world use HID products and services to navigate their everyday lives, and over 2 billion things are connected through HID. We work with governments, educational institutions, hospitals, financial institutions, industrial businesses, and some of the most innovative companies on the planet. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, HID Global has over 4500 employees worldwide and operates international offices that support more than 100 countries. HID Global® is an ASSA ABLOY Group brand. HID Global has is the trusted source for secure identity solutions for millions of customers and users around the world. In India, we have two Engineering Centre (Bangalore and Chennai). Global Engineering Team is based in Chennai and one of the Business Unit Engineering team is based in Bangalore. Check us out: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo
  
  
LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/hidglobal/mycompany/
  
  
**Are You Ready to Join the Team?**
Our company is committed to finding the best and the brightest talent to help us reach the top. If you are a dynamic, highly skilled, experienced Cloud engineer and technology enthusiast, and you enjoy working in a rapid pace within a rapidly growing business environment, then you will want to consider this position. If you excel at communication, collaboration, and unrelenting innovation, we want to talk to you. And if you bring dedication, positive energy and integrity to the table, you just might be the right fit for our team.
  
  
**Qualifications**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities (Other Duties May Be Assigned)**

* Run vulnerability intake, triage, prioritization, remediation tracking, escalation, and closure processes across assigned product areas.
* Collaborate closely with Information Security, Development, Product Security, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance teams to coordinate vulnerability response activities.
* Assess, triage, prioritize, and coordinate remediation of vulnerabilities identified through SAST, SCA, secret scanning, penetration testing, security assessments, and external researchers.
* Track remediation commitments, validate progress with development teams, monitor SLA compliance, and escalate overdue or at-risk vulnerabilities.
* Lead emergency response or “fire-fighting” calls for urgent and critical vulnerabilities, bringing together the required stakeholders to define containment, remediation, validation, communication, and closure actions.
* Manage coordinated vulnerability disclosure activities, including external intake, researcher communications, vulnerability validation coordination, and disclosure timelines.
* Maintain vulnerability-management playbooks, operating procedures, exception workflows, risk-acceptance records, and evidence required for audits or customer inquiries.
* Support SBOM-driven response activities for third-party and open-source component vulnerabilities.
* Develop practical guidance and training that enable product teams to independently execute their vulnerability-management responsibilities.
* Produce clear operational and executive reporting on risk posture, remediation performance, disclosure activity, and program improvements.
* Identify gaps in adoption or process effectiveness and recommend scalable improvements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with SBOMs, software supply-chain vulnerabilities, and open-source component governance.
* Experience in a large, multi-product or regulated environment.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, GIAC, or comparable credentials.

**Experience and/or Education Qualification:**

* 10–12 years of experience in product security, application security, PSIRT, vulnerability management, or a related security discipline.
* Demonstrated experience managing the end-to-end vulnerability lifecycle in a software or connected-product environment.
* Experience with application security capabilities and vulnerability sources, including SAST, SCA, secret scanning, penetration testing, and secure handling of credentials and secrets in development and CI/CD environments.
* Experience coordinating or participating in penetration testing, including reviewing findings, validating impact, and driving remediation.
* Strong understanding of vulnerability severity, CVSS, remediation prioritization, common application-security vulnerabilities, and secure software development practices.
* Experience coordinating response for urgent or critical security vulnerabilities under tight timelines.
* Experience with coordinated vulnerability disclosure or PSIRT operations.
* Ability to work effectively with distributed engineering teams and influence action without direct authority.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risk clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

****Why apply?****

* Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers.
* Integrity: You are results-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves to feel appreciated and accepted.

This opportunity may be open to flexible working arrangements.
  
  
HID is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Minority/Female/Disability/Veteran/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation.
  
  
**We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!**
On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.
  
  
When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

****Job Description****
The I.T. Systems Administrator is responsible for the support, administration, maintenance, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of business-critical on-premises infrastructure and Microsoft Azure cloud environment.
  
  
This position requires an experienced, highly self-motivated IT professional who can work independently while collaborating effectively within a global IT organization. The successful candidate will support a diverse portfolio of hybrid infrastructure environment consisting of Dell server platforms, enterprise storage systems, Windows Server technologies, Active Directory services, Hyper-V virtualization, file services, and Azure cloud infrastructure..
  
  
Working as part of the Infrastructure team, this role collaborates closely with Application, Network, Development, Data, Project, and Service Desk teams, as well as external software vendors and service providers.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a strong infrastructure and cloud professional with expertise across on-premises data center technologies, Microsoft Azure services, enterprise storage platforms, Windows Server, Hyper-V, and Active Directory. A strong focus on Azure infrastructure and code provisioning.
  
  
This position is fully onsite and reports remotely within a global IT organization.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Administer, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot Dell server infrastructure, enterprise storage platforms, and Windows-based infrastructure services.
* Manage and maintain enterprise file servers, file shares, permissions, and storage resources.
* Support and maintain clustered Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization environments.
* Administer and maintain Microsoft Azure and AWS infrastructure services.
* Proactively identify technical debt, supportability risks, and opportunities for improvement across on-premises infrastructure and cloud environments.
* Provision, deploy, and manage Azure resources following governance and security standards.
* Manage Azure RBAC, Entra ID permissions, Azure Firewall, DNS services, network security and connectivity solutions.
* Design, implement, and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using Terraform as a core competency of cloud administration for provisioning, configuration management, and deployment processes.
* Participate in application and infrastructure deployment projects and ensure operational readiness prior to go-live.
* Review technical documentation and ensure supported systems remain properly documented and maintainable.
* Work within established ITIL processes for Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis across server, storage, virtualization, cloud, networking, DNS, authentication, and security layers.
* Provide 3rd Level infrastructure support for complex technical incidents and service requests locally and remotely.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, incident reports, and Root Cause Analysis documentation.
* Collaborate with software vendors, service providers, business users, project teams, and global IT teams to resolve complex technical issues.
* Participate in regular remote meetings and communications using Microsoft Teams, email, and ticket management systems.

**Education**

* Computer Science degree, Information Technology degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

****The Following Certifications Are Considered An Asset:****

* IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL)
* Microsoft certifications related to Windows Server, Virtualization, Azure, Infrastructure Administration, or Enterprise Applications
* Cisco CCNA or similar

****Experience & Qualifications****

* 5+ years of experience implementing, supporting, and managing enterprise infrastructure environments in a complex, global environment.
* Strong experience with Dell servers, storage systems including NAS / SAN, Windows Server, Active Directory, Hyper-V and file services.
* Strong Azure administration experience including provisioning, permissions, firewall and DNS management.
* Hands-on Terraform experience for Infrastructure as Code deployments
* Experience working within ITIL-based support processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to independently learn and support unfamiliar systems and technologies.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to create technical documentation, operational procedures, incident reports, and Root Cause Analysis documentation.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Knowledge of AWS core infrastructure and cloud services.
* Experience with Citrix, Linux, Docker, or related infrastructure technologies.
* Experience with Dynatrace monitoring solutions.
* Experience troubleshooting Kerberos authentication issues.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation.

**Key Competencies**

* Self-motivated and highly independent.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Continuous learning mindset.

**Success Profile**
The ideal candidate is a hands-on Infrastructure and Cloud professional who successfully bridges traditional data center operations with modern cloud engineering practices. They combine deep expertise in Windows infrastructure, virtualization, storage, and enterprise networking with strong Azure administration and automation capabilities. Through a proactive approach to troubleshooting, Root Cause Analysis, and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, they ensure reliable, secure, and scalable hybrid infrastructure platforms. The candidate is highly self-motivated, continuously expands their technical expertise, and takes full ownership of supporting and improving business-critical systems and services across both on-premises and cloud environments.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence, and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
The Business Management and Controls organization enables business delivery on all GT functions including strategy, AIT Management, workspace management, workforce governance, employee engagement, risk management, application security and vulnerability assessments, portfolio governance and integrated reporting. Additionally the team also provides support on enhanced approvals for resource requisitions, campus hiring program and global mobility.
  
  
**Job Description\***
.
  
  
This role reviews high‑risk security exceptions such as access to blocked websites, proxy or IAM control bypasses, and SSL inspection exclusions. The role assesses business need versus security risk, understands architecture, network and SDLC flows, ensures proper compensating controls, partners with security and risk teams, maintains audit‑ready documentation, tracks trends, and supports informed, time‑bound risk decisions.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***
Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Review and assess high‑risk security and access exceptions, including:

+ Access to critical or high‑risk blocked websites
+ Proxy authentication bypass requests
+ IAM control deviations (authentication, authorization, MFA, service identities)
+ SSL/TLS content inspection exclusions

* Perform end‑to‑end risk analysis by evaluating architectural flows, network paths, identity boundaries, and trust relationships
* Assess the impact of bypassing enterprise security controls, including changes to attack surface, data exposure risk, and monitoring gaps
* Translate technical control deviations into clear business‑level risk statements aligned to regulatory and security standards
* Validate that exception requests are justified, time‑bound, least‑privileged, and aligned to documented business requirements
* Evaluate the adequacy of compensating controls (network restrictions, enhanced logging, multi factor authentication, monitoring, expiry enforcement)
* Partner with GIS, Software owners, Application teams, Network engineering teams, and Risk stakeholders to ensure informed decision‑making
* Apply SDLC and environment awareness (DEV, SIT, UAT, PROD) when evaluating risk tolerance and enforcement expectations
* Drive remediation plans or architectural fixes to reduce reliance on repeated or long‑term exceptions
* Track and facilitate closure or renewal of exceptions with defined ownership, rationale, and expiry timelines
* Identify portfolio‑level trends and systemic risks, such as recurring control bypasses or accumulating residual risk
* Publish and maintain risk dashboards and management metrics (exception aging, high‑risk exposure, control gaps)
* Ensure all exception decisions are audit‑ready, well‑documented, and compliant with AIT and enterprise security standards
* Promote a strong enterprise risk culture, reinforcing that exceptions are temporary, risk‑owned decisions

**Requirements**
**Education\***

* Any Graduation / Post Graduation

**Experience Range\***

* 15 to 20 years

**Foundational skills\***

* In‑depth understanding of security control objectives and the risks of control bypass
* Strong knowledge of:
* Proxy architectures and internet access controls
* IAM controls and identity risk scenarios
* SSL/TLS encryption and content inspection concepts
* Ability to analyze architectural diagrams, data flows, and control touchpoints
* Risk‑sensitive mindset with the ability to identify, escalate, and document high‑impact security risks
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills suitable for governance, audit, and senior stakeholders
* Experience producing clear exception rationale, risk statements, and mitigation documentation
* Ability to manage multiple exception cases across portfolios while meeting governance timelines
* Commitment to continuous learning in emerging threats, security architectures, and enterprise risk practices
* Relevant information security certification preferred:
* CISSP, CISA, CSSLP, CEH, or equivalent

**Desired skills\***

* Ability to articulate complex technical risks in a clear, concise, and defensible manner
* Proven experience collaborating with cross‑functional teams (Security, Architecture, Development, Risk, Compliance)
* Strong analytical and decision‑making skills grounded in facts, evidence, and risk impact

title: Staff/Senior Operations Engineer
description:
**Job Type**
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
**About CloudBees:**
CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
  
  
Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.
  
  
CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
  
  
Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
  
  
Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.
  
  
**About the Role:**
To support the delivery of CloudBees products (both internal and external), our Operations team designs, deploys, secures and manages a variety of software systems and the related GCP / AWS infrastructure that underpins these software engineering objectives. Our guiding principle is simple - “Make Engineering Faster”. Underpinning this are the challenges of security, process change, technical change that all must be met to varying degrees. Further, we are passionate about reducing the manual work that plagues IT teams - Engineering / Ops / Support / Security - and are empowered to re-engineer processes and technology to achieve those objectives.
  
  
We are looking for someone who:
  
  

* Is able to troubleshoot complex issues calmly.
* An open communicator, capable of bringing new ideas to the team
* Is able to learn from colleagues at all levels
* Understands, and is motivated by, rapidly changing technologies and has demonstrable competence with modern AI tools.

You are:
  
  

* self-motivated and enjoy solving problems
* excited by the opportunity to automate yourself out of recurring workable to self-organize and document your work and decisions effectively
* You will liaise directly with the software engineers across all teams, ensuring that decisions are agreed internally and externally to Operations and that they meet our technical and non-technical objectives.

How you’ll work:
  
  

* In a geographically distributed team (APAC, US, EMEA) of peers
* Choose your own work in tandem with the team, team-leader, and manager
* Flexible working hours - while there will be some core hours required for meeting with Engineering and Operations teams - much latitude is given in getting work done.
* Hybrid work based out of our Chennai hub

**Requirements**
**What you’ll Do:**
**Team-building**
- inside the team and across teams - you’ll be proposing new ideas and helping implement them
**Thinking**
- coming up with new ways of solving problems - and working with the team to prove them out and then implement them. Keeping up to speed with the latest technology, and proactively making use of tools like coding assistants and AI agents to accelerate your work.
**Documenting**
- describing problems, how your proposed solution solves those problems, and how your implemented solutions are operated.
**Optimizing**
- working with Engineering teams to optimize their build systems. Managing and developing tools which enable Engineers to ship faster.
**Defining**
- writing / modifying Terraform to handle our infrastructure, and helping teams define their infrastructure using our modules.
**Coding**
- you’ll be writing code in Golang - we occasionally write code in TypeScript, Python, and Groovy
**Securing**

* working with our security team to drive operational change in engineering teams
* working with our security team to drive organizational security changes (logging, auditing, monitoring, alerting)

**Observing**
- adding the right monitoring so that we are alerted before our customers notice, and not alerted when the system is able to heal itself
**Alerting**
- getting alerts and working with team members to solve the initial problem, documenting the problem and then working out how to stop them happening again
**DevOps / DevSecOps**
- We’re not “DevOps” engineers, but we do help our teams become more proficient in doing Dev and Ops (and embracing Total Ownership). We build the guard rails to help them do it safely and align tech-stacks across the company.
**What you will work on**
-
  
  

* IaaS - GCP, AWS
* AI tooling and automation - Claude Code, Codex, AWS Bedrock Agentcore, Software Factories
* Platform tools - Kubernetes, terraform, helm, docker
* Language tools - Golang
* Engineering tools - Jenkins, Backstage
* Operations tools - PagerDuty, DataDog

**Role Requirements:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or related field
* 8+ years working in a DevOps style environment - building automations, writing software, solving problems
* 2+ years working in AWS (preferred) or GCP
* 2+ years experience in a high level programming language (Golang / Python / Ruby / Java or similar)
* Experience of working asynchronously in a distributed team.
* Experience of contributing to your team’s technical strategy
* Strong self organization skills and communication skills

You have experience in:
  
  

* programming in various languages and domains
* Development with agentic AI and administration of tools
* the "modern Ops stack" (e.g. monitoring, alerting, cloud-based provisioning, Docker, Kubernetes)
* Linux systems administration
* cloud-based operations (GCP, AWS, or Azure)
* cluster orchestration and management tools (e.g. k8s / ECS / Terraform / etc)
* continuous integration / continuous delivery tools (Jenkins / Tekton etc)
* modern software engineering practices: code reviews, unit / acceptance testing, source control, etc.
* You have experience using work tools like GSuite, GitHub, Jira, Confluence, and Slack.
* Experience of managing and responding to production incidents

**Position Purpose**

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct comprehensive risk evaluations for both new supplier onboarding and the continuous monitoring of existing suppliers.
* Assess multi-dimensional risks, including financial stability (liquidity/solvency), economic dependency, financial security, and Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR).

* Collaborate with Procurement teams to define, implement, and monitor supplier remediation plans.
* Provide on-demand supplier risk assessments to support Buyers in procurement decision-making.
* Deliver professional risk opinions and actionable insights during critical or high-impact supplier situations.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization to enhance the efficiency of the TPRM lifecycle.

Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Sanctions & AML Screening: Conduct deep-dive screening of suppliers against global sanctions lists (OFAC, EU, UN) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulations.
* UBO Identification: Perform detailed investigations into Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) to ensure transparency and prevent conflict of interest or shell company risks.
* Regulatory Horizon Scanning: Stay updated on evolving global regulations (such as the EU Supply Chain Due Diligence Directive) to ensure KYS processes remain compliant.
* PEP Screening: Monitor and assess risks associated with Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) within supplier ownership structures.
* Monitor real-time alerts, adverse media, and critical information regarding the supplier landscape.
* Utilize advanced Open-Source Intelligence techniques to detect negative news or reputational threats in multiple languages or local jurisdictions.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Ensure the integrity of internal and external risk management tools by maintaining real-time data updates based on performed assessments.
* Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of KYS processes, workflows, and methodologies.

* In-depth knowledge of Know Your Supplier (KYS), KYC, and AML (Anti-Money Laundering) regulations.
* Proven expertise in Risk Assessment methodologies and the application of a Risk-Based Approach (RBA).
* Advanced proficiency in Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO/BO) identification and verification procedures.
* Ability to perform financial health assessments, including the review of balance sheets and financial statements.
* Experience in conducting sanctions screening, PEP (Politically Exposed Persons) identification, and adverse media monitoring.
* Proficiency in utilizing risk management platforms, screening databases, and MS Excel for data analysis.
* Self-motivated and results-driven with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to follow through on tasks.
* Methodical, analytical, and highly organized with superior problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate risk findings clearly.

* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet strict regulatory deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

**Requirements**
– BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or equivalent technical experience.

– 3–5 years of hands-on experience configuring, analyzing and troubleshooting Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) scans.
  
  
– Strong understanding of Secure SDLC, OWASP Top 10, NIST, ISO, PCI and industry security best practices.
  
  
– Hands-on experience performing Threat Modeling and security risk assessments using methodologies such as STRIDE, PASTA, TRIKE or ATT&CK.

– Strong knowledge of authentication, authorization, input validation, output encoding, session management, cryptography and secure coding practices.
  
  
– Experience with SAST, DAST, IAST and Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Checkmarx, Tenable or equivalent.

– Experience securing cloud-native applications, microservices, serverless architectures, Kubernetes, Docker and AWS environments.
  
  
– Hands-on experience working in Linux environments with proficiency in Linux shell scripting and command-line tools for security analysis, automation and troubleshooting.
  
  
– Experience with vulnerability management, penetration testing, security scanning and remediation.
  
  
– Experience with anomaly detection and observability platforms such as ELK, Prometheus, Grafana and InfluxDB.
  
  
– Strong understanding of operating system, application, network and database security architectures.
  
  
– Experience working with Agile development methodologies and tools such as Jira, GitHub and Confluence.
  
  
– Excellent communication skills with the ability to work independently and collaborate with developers, architects, product teams and senior leadership to define security requirements, technical designs and product strategy.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
– Drive strategic product security initiatives to ensure new and legacy applications and infrastructure comply with organizational security policies and industry frameworks such as ISO, PCI, OWASP and NIST.
  
  
– Perform threat modeling of applications and technology designs to identify security risks early and mature threat modeling practices across engineering teams.
  
  
– Act as the security subject matter expert for architects and engineering teams by conducting security architecture reviews, assessing risks and recommending appropriate security controls and mitigations.
  
  
– Lead strategic security initiatives including security automation, continuous improvement and implementation of internal security policies and procedures.
  
  
– Identify, analyze and remediate security vulnerabilities through static analysis, dynamic analysis, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), penetration testing and security scanning.
  
  
– Prevent attack exposure through threat modeling, system audits, system hardening and security policy compliance.
  
  
– Lead application security reviews for smart IIoT devices, web applications and cloud infrastructure.
  
  
– Contribute to the secure implementation and deployment of enterprise software solutions.
  
  
– Develop and enhance DevSecOps capabilities by integrating SAST, DAST, IAST and SCA tools into SDLC and CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
– Build security tooling, automation, dashboards and observability capabilities to improve operational efficiency and visibility into the organization’s security posture.
  
  
– Work closely with development, architecture and operations teams to secure microservices, serverless applications, containers, Kubernetes platforms and cloud-native environments.
  
  
– Work in Linux environments using shell scripting and command-line tools to automate security tasks, analyze findings and support security investigations.
  
  
– Utilize anomaly detection and observability platforms such as ELK, Prometheus, Grafana and InfluxDB to improve security monitoring and analysis.
  
  
– Define, track and own security metrics and KPIs to measure the effectiveness of the application security and security automation programs.

title: Associate Director, Third Party Intelligence & Investigations
description:
**Job Summary**
Client & Third Party Security (CTPS) is a specialist team within the Bank’s Group Threat Management (GTM) function, forming part of Information & Cyber Security (ICS) function. The team plays a critical role in delivering the Group’s ICS Strategy by helping build a comprehensive, threat-focused understanding of its external ecosystem, including third party vendors, key partners, and clients. CTPS helps protect the Bank by managing third-party cyber risk end-to-end through delivery of Third Party Security Assessments, contractual control oversight, third party continuous monitoring, detection, analysis and investigation of third party incidents, and targeted remediation of third party security observations. As the threat landscape continues to evolve, CTPS is going through an exciting transformation to become more threat-led, risk-focused and efficient — strengthening supply chain security capabilities and improving detection and remediation of interconnected third-party risks.
  
  
The Associate Director, Third Party Intelligence & Incident Investigations will be part of a specialist team responsible for the proactive detection, analysis and investigation of cyber security incidents impacting the Bank’s third party ecosystem. Sitting within CTPS, this role will play a critical part in strengthening the Bank’s ability to identify emerging third party threats, assess potential exposure, coordinate response activity and clearly articulate risk to senior stakeholders.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring deep expertise across a broad range of cyber security domains including cyber threat intelligence, forensic investigations, incident response and third party security risk management. They will be responsible for supporting investigations into third party incidents and ensuring findings are translated into clear business, operational, client and regulatory risk insights. The role will require strong judgement in high-pressure situations, including determining the potential impact of incidents on Bank data, services, systems, clients and critical third party dependencies.
  
  
This role will also be responsible for engaging directly with senior internal and external stakeholders, including CISOs, CIOs and senior representatives of breached or impacted third parties. The role holder must be able to communicate clearly, challenge effectively, obtain meaningful assurance from third parties and brief complex technical and investigative findings in a clear, concise and business-relevant manner.
  
  
As CTPS continues to strengthen its threat-led and intelligence-enabled approach to third party security risk management, this role will be central to ensuring the Bank remains responsive to a fast-moving external threat landscape.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Support the ongoing maturity of CTPS’ third party incident investigations and intelligence programme, ensuring alignment with the wider ICS strategy and the Bank’s approach to managing third party cyber security risk.
* Support the evolution of third party incident detection and investigation capabilities to ensure the Bank remains responsive to a fast-moving, increasingly complex and supply-chain-focused external threat landscape.
* Identify and implement opportunities to enhance the Bank’s overall security posture through new detection capabilities, improved intelligence workflows, enhanced investigation standards and broader programme improvements.

**Business**

* Maintain awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy, operating model and third party ecosystem.
* Facilitate business continuity by proactively identifying, assessing and helping mitigate cyber threats targeting the Bank’s clients, third party suppliers and wider supply chain.
* Lead engagements with Contract Managers when investigating third party compromises, ensuring business stakeholders understand potential impact, required actions and escalation pathways.
* Translate complex cyber threat intelligence and investigation findings into clear business, operational and regulatory impact assessments.

**Processes**

* Responsible for operating third party incident detection, triage, investigation, impact assessment and intelligence reporting processes.
* Ensure suspected third party incidents are recorded, validated, investigated, classified and escalated in line with CTPS operating procedures and relevant incident management requirements.
* Maintain rules, alerts and workflows to enhance discovery of relevant intelligence across threat intelligence platforms, monitoring tools, dark web sources, ransomware leak sites and other relevant intelligence sources.
* Pivot on relevant Indicators of Compromise, including domains, IP addresses, infrastructure, threat actor identifiers and other artefacts, to investigate associated threats, actors, infrastructure and potential Bank exposure.
* Adopt consistent investigation standards, evidence requirements, quality assurance expectations and documentation practices.
* Ensure lessons learned from investigations are fed back into relevant control domains, including threat detection, continuous monitoring, third party reassessments, control uplift and executive reporting.

**Risk Management**

* Identify, assess, monitor and support mitigation of cyber risks arising from incidents impacting the Bank’s third party suppliers, clients and broader third party ecosystem.
* Ensure timely escalation of material third party incidents, suspected compromises, control weaknesses and emerging threat trends through appropriate CTPS, ICS and Group risk channels.
* Provide risk-based recommendations to support containment, assurance requests, remediation actions, reassessment triggers, continuous monitoring prioritisation and potential disconnection decisioning.
* Support responsibilities under the Group’s Risk Management Framework by ensuring third party incident risks are identified, assessed, documented, escalated and monitored in a controlled and consistent manner.
* Provide effective challenge where third party responses, assurance evidence, remediation plans or business risk decisions do not sufficiently address the underlying cyber risk exposure.

**Governance**

Verizon is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Principal Security Engineer to join our Data as a Service (DaaS) & Analytics team. You will architect and build modern data products, leveraging the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem to design scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and serverless application architectures.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Architecting and optimizing large-scale security data repositories within Google BigQuery, ensuring efficient partitioning, clustering, and storage tiering to support multi-terabyte analytical queries.
* Designing and implementing robust, low-latency data pipelines using GCP Dataflow services (Apache Beam) to ingest, transform, and aggregate batch and streaming data from disparate security sources into centralized data platforms.

* Leading analytics engineers technically to architect and deploy production-grade automation solutions. Utilize GCP Cloud Run and Cloud Functions to build scalable, event-driven microservices and high-performance APIs that expose enterprise security data.

* Driving the transition from standard visualization to a scalable data product model, establishing a comprehensive Looker dashboard catalog to streamline enterprise risk forecasting.
* Developing and maintaining a standardized semantic layer using LookML (Looker Modeling Language) to ensure data consistency, security access controls, and reusability across all security domains.
* Building comprehensive business cases and data models surrounding Enterprise Security Data Analysis and Reporting to drive long-term security investments.

**What We’re Looking For...**

* Proven experience architecting and developing solutions within Google Cloud Platform, specifically leveraging containerized deployments via Cloud Run and serverless computing via Cloud Functions.
* Deep technical mastery of Google BigQuery architecture, including nested/repeated fields, materialized views, and BigQuery Omni or ML capabilities.
* Hands-on experience building streaming and batch data processing pipelines using GCP Dataflow services.
* Advanced proficiency in writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Strong hands-on coding expertise in Python to perform advanced data analysis, data mining, DevSecOps automation, and pipeline orchestration.
* Familiarity with deploying AI-driven automation workflows to improve data pipeline resilience.
* Experience utilizing visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Thoughtspot) to build data-driven stories tailored for business users at all levels.
* Experience embedding Looker visualizations directly into serverless applications or enterprise API frameworks is highly desirable.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor degree in Computer Science/Information Systems or six or more years of work experience.
* Eight or more years of professional experience in data analytics, business analysis or comparable analytics position.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Ability to write SQL against a relational database in order to analyze and test data.
* Experience with modern DataOps/DevSecOps orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, CI/CD pipelines) applied directly to data engineering.
* Working knowledge on Threat, Risk and Vulnerability Management is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of securing cloud data delivery layers (OAuth, OIDC, API Gateways) and enforcing data privacy/governance standards.
* Cloud Certifications

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Experience in technology leadership, architecture, and Agile methodologies.
* Communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Problem solving skills to develop quick yet sound solutions to resolve complex issues.
* Experience in driving AI automation, delivering high performing and scalable applications.

40

AI Security Analyst, Infrastructure
  
  
As an AI Security Analyst specializing in Infrastructure in Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice, you will own technical workstreams that secure the cloud, network, container and model-serving foundations used to run generative AI and agentic workloads. As an AI Security Analyst on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for
  
  

* Build secure AI landing-zone components across cloud accounts or subscriptions, networks, identity, compute, Kubernetes, model services and observability.
* Design and deploy secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud or Kubernetes-based platforms.
* Lead implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets, artifact controls, IaC and policy enforcement.
* Engineer and review Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience and controlled enterprise integration.

Deloitte Cyber's Cyber for AI practice helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security and operations.
  
  
We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data or infrastructure risk.

description:

The Senior Security Engineer - Platforms, Digital Workplace & AI Enablement sits within IDP's Security Platforms and Engineering team and provides senior, hands-on engineering capability across security platforms, Digital Workplace security, vulnerability management, patching governance, reporting, automation, penetration testing, AI enablement and security engineering practices.

title: Lead Security Engineer
description:
**About Chargebee:**

Chargebee is a subscription billing and revenue management platform powering some of the fastest-growing brands around the world today, including Calendly, Hopin, Pret-a-Manger, Freshworks, Okta, Study.com, and others. Thousands of SaaS and subscription-first businesses process over billions of dollars in revenue every year through the Chargebee platform.

Headquartered in San Francisco, USA, our 500+ team members work remotely throughout the world, including India, the Netherlands, Paris, Spain, Australia, and the USA.

Chargebee has raised over $480 million in capital and is funded by Accel, Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Steadview Capital, and Sapphire Ventures. And we’re on a mission to push the boundaries of subscription revenue operations. Not just ours, but every customer and prospective business on a recurring revenue model.

**Job Summary:**

You will be operating at a cross section of cutting edge tech transformation operating on AWS & Azure stack. It entails a deep understanding of running a security operations center in Macintosh & Cloud native ecosystem; with globally distributed teams operating 24\*7. primary focus on optimizing incident response & increasing cyber resilience. This is an opportunity to build / lead highly efficient cyber security incident response team operating 24\*7 covering 4 critical layers : IT, Identity, Cloud Infrastructure & Product. Role will serve as a technical leader together with the team to enhance cyber resilience of product offerings of Chargebee.

You will be partnering with colleagues in the product engineering, business, infrastructure & GRC organizations to build response & recovery muscle of Chargebee. You will also have the opportunity to engineer & integrate new sources to improve detection efficiency, while managing a small team of skilled SOC Analysts.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**SOC Engineering:**

* Continuously scout for sources of detection and integrate new sources with SOC.
* Critically examine relevance of logs & its value to incident response.
* Enrichment of existing alerts & reduction of false positive alerts.
* Regular maintenance of SOC infrastructure & its cost management.
* Play a pivotal role in making opinionated tools decisions.

**SOC Operations:**

* Manage and operate our SIEM platform, ensuring efficient log collection,correlation, and aggregation.
* Conduct proactive threat hunting to identify and respond to potential security incidents early.
* Analyze security logs and generate reports to identify trends and improve security posture.
* Own & maintain incident ticketing tool to logging all security incidents
* Governance, tracking & measuring of SOC ops through KPIs
* Collaborate with product engineering, program management, Legal, Privacy and GRC teams to know key stakeholders required during incident response.
* Build high performing security ops team with a high sense of accountability & ability to take decisions in ambiguous situations.
* Configure and manage perimeter security solutions like WAFs.

**Ops Management**
:

* Cost Management : Keep a handle on approved budget , run rate etc and efficiently manage unit economics of operations.
* Partner Management : Have an active engagement with managed services partners on quality of services , SLA adherence & overall delivery of services.

**Automation**
:

* Lead automation initiatives within SOC to simplify reporting, dashboarding & reduce Ops fatigue.

**Culture**
:

* Champion adoption of Agile practices with the Security team.
* Enhance product IQ within all members of the SOC team.
* Mentor & coach SOC analysts and help them in career progression.

**Must Haves:**

* 7+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering & security ops in global setting - preferably in the financial or payments domain.
* Excellent scripting & querying skills - specially on Splunk & ELK.
* Good knowledge of Python, Powershell & AWS security services.
* Experience of building perimeter protection using AWS WAF , Cloudflare , Akamai etc.
* Experience in building enterprise logging management systems using either Splunk, ELK etc.
* Extensive experience of adopting IAC (infrastructure as a code) using either AWS cloud formation templates, Terraform etc. and building security monitoring gates to identify deviations
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written; ability to condense complicated scenarios into simple, risk-based assessments
* Effective team player with experience coaching and supporting junior team members

**Nice to haves:**

* Cloud specific accreditations like AWS Solutions Architect, DevOps engineer, Azure Solutions architect etc.
* Security specific certifications like GIAC, CISSP, CCSP, CISM etc.
* Experience of building testing automation using modern testing tools like Github Advanced Security , Snyk etc.

**Skills and Experience:**

* 7+ years of experience in infrastructure security and risk analysis techniques, or related fields such as software engineering and architecture
* Domain experience in payment tech / fintech / banking is a plus.

**Education and Experience:**

Any Bachelor’s degree/ Post Graduates

title: Cyber Security Architect
description:
**Company Description**
Clear InfoSec is a New York City–headquartered, minority- and women-owned cybersecurity firm founded in 2017. The company specializes in information security, offering services such as secure software development, secure IT and communications architecture, infrastructure design, and digital transformation. Clear InfoSec is ISO 27001 certified, demonstrating adherence to internationally recognized security standards and robust security practices. The team focuses on proactive, end-to-end protection of digital assets by assessing vulnerabilities, designing resilient security measures, and implementing tailored solutions. With a strong track record across diverse industries, Clear InfoSec positions itself as a trusted, innovative partner for organizations seeking to strengthen their cyber defenses.

**Role Description**
The Cyber Security Architect will design, implement, and maintain secure architectures across applications, networks, and infrastructure to protect Clear InfoSec’s clients from emerging cyber threats. Day-to-day responsibilities include assessing existing environments, conducting threat modeling and risk assessments, defining security requirements, and creating reference architectures and patterns aligned with industry standards and regulatory frameworks. The role involves collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and business stakeholders to integrate security into solution design, performing security reviews of new technologies, and guiding secure configuration and hardening practices. The Cyber Security Architect will also contribute to security policies, standards, and best practices, support incident response and root cause analysis, and provide technical mentorship to other team members. This is a full-time remote role.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Security Architecture Design, including development of secure solution blueprints, reference architectures, and integration patterns.
* Candidates should possess expertise in Application Security, such as secure SDLC practices, code review, threat modeling, and remediation of application-level vulnerabilities.
* Candidates should possess deep knowledge of Cybersecurity and Information Security, including risk management, security controls, governance, compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST), and security policy development.
* Candidates should possess practical experience in Network Security, including segmentation, firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, zero-trust principles, and secure cloud networking.
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or SABSA/TOGAF with a security focus are highly beneficial.
* Demonstrated experience in cloud security (AWS, Azure, GCP), infrastructure-as-code, and secure configuration management is preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, and documentation skills, with the ability to work effectively in remote, cross-functional teams.

If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!
  
  
****Job Description****
**Position Summary**
The I.T. Systems Administrator is responsible for the support, administration, maintenance, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of business-critical enterprise applications and supporting infrastructure within a complex manufacturing environment.
  
  
This position requires an experienced, highly self-motivated IT professional who can work independently while collaborating effectively within a global IT organization. The successful candidate will support a diverse portfolio of ERP, warehouse management, engineering, manufacturing, analytics, and legacy business systems while ensuring their stability, performance, security, and long-term supportability.
  
  
Working as part of the Enterprise Applications team, this role collaborates closely with Infrastructure, Network, Development, Data, Project, and Service Desk teams, as well as external software vendors and service providers.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a strong technical generalist with expertise across enterprise applications, Microsoft SQL Server technologies, and supporting infrastructure platforms. The ability to independently learn unfamiliar systems and assume operational ownership of business-critical applications is essential.
  
  
This position is fully onsite and reports remotely within a global IT organization.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Administer, support, monitor, and troubleshoot business-critical enterprise applications, including ERP, warehouse management, engineering, manufacturing, analytics, and other operational systems.
* Develop technical expertise and operational ownership of assigned applications and services.
* Proactively identify technical debt, supportability risks, and opportunities for improvement across enterprise applications and supporting infrastructure.
* Contribute to projects and continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing technical debt, improving system stability, and modernizing legacy technologies.
* Troubleshoot issues across application, database, operating system, infrastructure, authentication, and integration layers.
* Administer and support Microsoft SQL Server environments, including clustered installations, Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) platforms, and related technologies such as SSIS, SSAS, and SSRS.
* Collaborate with Development, Data, BI, and DBA teams to identify and resolve database and application performance issues.
* Administer and support Microsoft Windows Server environments.
* Support Active Directory administration, authentication services, and Kerberos-related troubleshooting.
* Support and maintain virtualized environments primarily based on Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Support Azure-hosted business applications, databases, and analytical solutions.
* Participate in application and infrastructure deployment projects and ensure operational readiness prior to go-live.
* Review technical documentation and ensure supported systems remain properly documented and maintainable.
* Work within established ITIL processes for Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring and business-critical incidents.
* Collect and analyze diagnostic information using tools such as PerfMon, Windows Event Viewer, SQL Server tools, Dynatrace, Spotlight, and application logs.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, incident reports, and Root Cause Analysis documentation.
* Collaborate with software vendors, service providers, business users, project teams, and global IT teams to resolve complex technical issues.
* Participate in regular remote meetings and communications using Microsoft Teams, email, and ticket management systems.

**Education**

* Computer Science degree, Information Technology degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

****The Following Certifications Are Considered An Asset:****

* IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL)
* Microsoft certifications related to Windows Server, SQL Server, Azure, Infrastructure Administration, or Enterprise Applications
* Citrix certifications

****Experience & Qualifications****

* 5+ years of experience implementing, supporting, and managing enterprise applications and systems technologies in a complex, global environment.
* Strong hands-on experience administering Microsoft Windows Server environments.
* Strong hands-on experience administering Microsoft SQL Server environments.
* Experience supporting ERP and business-critical enterprise applications.
* Experience supporting ERP solutions such as Microsoft Dynamics AX.
* Experience supporting Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) environments and Microsoft SQL Server technologies including SSIS, SSAS, and SSRS.
* Experience troubleshooting SQL Server performance issues and supporting clustered SQL Server environments.
* Experience administering Microsoft Active Directory and supporting Microsoft Hyper-V environments.

policies, and warehouse sizing.

stakeholders.

* Coordinate effectively across multiple engineering and application teams.

title: Data Privacy Specialist
description:
**Role Overview**

The Privacy Specialist is responsible for supporting and strengthening the organization’s privacy and personal data protection program, with strong working knowledge of India’s Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act and applicable rules. The role focuses on privacy compliance, data handling practices, risk assessments, documentation, individual rights requests, and coordination with business and technical teams. Experience with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**DPDP Compliance & Privacy Governance**

* Maintain and support the organization’s privacy program in alignment with India’s DPDP Act and applicable rules and guidance
* Translate privacy obligations into practical policies, procedures, workflows, and controls for relevant business functions
* Support privacy governance activities, maintain compliance registers, and track implementation of privacy requirements
* Monitor changes in privacy laws, rules, and regulatory guidance and assess their potential impact on organizational practices

**Personal Data Lifecycle & Data Principal Rights**

* Support data mapping and records of personal data processing, including collection, use, sharing, retention, and deletion
* Help establish and maintain processes for handling data principal requests, grievances, consent withdrawal, and related communications, as applicable
* Review privacy notices, consent language, and data collection forms to help ensure transparency and appropriate purpose limitation
* Coordinate with business and technical teams to support retention schedules, deletion processes, and appropriate handling of personal data

**Privacy Risk Assessments & Incident Management**

* Conduct or coordinate privacy impact and risk assessments for new projects, products, vendors, and changes to personal data processing
* Identify privacy risks and recommend proportionate controls and remediation actions in collaboration with relevant teams
* Support the identification, assessment, escalation, and documentation of personal data breaches and privacy incidents
* Coordinate with Security, Legal, IT, and business stakeholders on incident response, required assessments, and applicable notification obligations

**Third-Party Privacy & GDPR (Added Advantage)**

* Review vendor and partner privacy practices, contractual clauses, and data-processing arrangements with relevant stakeholders
* Support privacy due diligence and track remediation of issues identified during vendor reviews or assessments
* Where applicable, assist with GDPR-related activities such as data subject rights, lawful bases, records of processing, and cross-border transfer reviews
* Help map privacy requirements across jurisdictions and identify common controls while accounting for jurisdiction-specific obligations

**Documentation, Training & Stakeholder Management**

* Maintain privacy policies, procedures, notices, assessment records, processing registers, and evidence of compliance
* Prepare privacy compliance updates, risk summaries, metrics, and reports for management and internal stakeholders
* Deliver or coordinate privacy awareness sessions and provide practical guidance to teams handling personal data

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 3–8 years of experience in data privacy, privacy compliance, information security GRC, legal compliance, or a related role
* Strong, demonstrable knowledge of India’s DPDP Act and applicable rules, including key obligations relating to notice, consent where applicable, data principal rights, safeguards, breach response, and accountability
* Experience with privacy documentation, data mapping, risk assessments, compliance reviews, and coordination with cross-functional stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Law, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field; relevant privacy or data protection experience may also be considered
* Working experience with DPDP, GDPR is an added advantage; certifications or training such as CIPP/A, CIPP/E, CIPM, or other relevant privacy qualifications are desirable
* Experience managing security incidents and crisis situations
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Cybersecurity, or related field

Certifications such as ( Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) - Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP) - Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE ), CDPO or ISO/IEC 27701.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
EY GDS Cybersecurity is seeking an experienced IAM AI Manager to help clients modernize their Identity and Access Management landscape through AI-led transformation. This role focuses on identifying where AI can improve IAM operations, governance, access risk management, privileged access, and non-human identity controls across enterprise environments.
  
  
You will work closely with clients and delivery teams to translate IAM challenges into practical, scalable, and reusable AI-enabled solutions. The role requires strong IAM domain understanding, consulting leadership, and the ability to shape solution approaches that improve identity lifecycle management, access governance, authentication, privileged access, compliance posture, and emerging areas such as agent, workload, and service identities.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a strong blend of IAM experience, AI awareness, solution design capability, and stakeholder-facing communication skills. This profile is expected to guide discovery, define the IAM-AI vision, support PoCs and MVPs, and help clients adopt intelligent, risk-aware, and secure identity operations without losing focus on control, auditability, and business value.

* Apply AI/ML techniques to support access risk analysis, anomaly detection, role mining, certification insights, and privileged access intelligence.
* Support secure NHI and agent identity governance covering discovery, inventory, authentication, authorization, and guardrails.

**IAM integration automation leadership**

* Lead client workshops, discovery, solution shaping, estimation, roadmap definition, and executive-level IAM-AI storytelling.
* Design AI-enabled governance capabilities across SailPoint, Saviynt, access reviews, lifecycle management, provisioning, SOD, and compliance reporting.
* Shape PAM automation and analytics across CyberArk, privileged access patterns, session monitoring, password rotation, secrets, and risk-based remediation.
* Develop client-ready insights and dashboards using identity data, analytics, automation, and visualization tools.

**Required Skills**

* 7+ years of experience in IAM, cybersecurity consulting, AI architecture, intelligent automation, or advanced analytics.

* Hands-on experience with Python, PowerShell, APIs, automation scripts, data pipelines, and cloud-native integration patterns.
* Good understanding of IAM protocols and controls including SAML, OAuth, OIDC, MFA, Conditional Access, federation, authorization, and certificate/key management.
* Strong consulting, communication, stakeholder management, presentation, and executive storytelling skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to IAM modernization, NHI governance, privileged access transformation, AI adoption, and responsible AI controls.
